Legs lack defined hooves and blend into ground plane—a classic diffusion model failure when applying rigid geometric patterns to organic forms. Cats and non-checkered sheep render with high fidelity (fine_grained_classifier strong tabby/ram identification, perceptual_quality_auditor null distortion). Guitars show minor edge haloing against wool (Router severity 2 fusion) but maintain structural integrity. Depth map confirms plausible scene geometry aside from guitar-sheep spatial misalignment. Overall authenticity compromised primarily by texture-to-geometry collapse on attributed sheep.
